note: Levels of user-supplied sounds and the gun reverb, read at load (Audio::loadCustom). casing_gain: x on the spent-case landing (1 = the SND4 level; 2 = twice it, about +6 dB), 0-3. reverb: per class, send (0-1: how much of the shot feeds the reverb) and tail_s (the tail's decay time outdoors; tunnels / Backrooms make it 1.4x longer): gun = every gun not listed below, mg = M249, MG 42, M2HB (carried and emplaced), fifty = the .50 sniper. guns (SND7): per gun id, a gain (x on its shot, 0-2; the limiter keeps it from clipping) or {gain, body}: body is the low-mid weight and saturation drive baked in at load (0 none, about 2-4; M249 / MG 42 2.2, M2HB 3, .50 4).
